lines.zh: 黑皮绷在骨头上，一步步挪
lines.en: My black hide stretches over bone as I shuffle on.
The netherrack burns my feet and I keep walking.
The bones at my neck creak with each step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都黑了
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass turns black.

lines.zh: 血在皮下慢慢流，热得发烫
lines.en: Blood creeps under my hide, running hot.

lines.zh: 瘸着腿也要走到你面前
lines.en: Limping, I still come to stand before you.
Four hooves pass along the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 身上的凋零味，风一吹就散开
lines.en: The wither stench on me scatters with the wind.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，你等得起就等
lines.en: I walk slowly; wait if you can.

lines.zh: 眼睛发白，看不清路也照样走
lines.en: My eyes are pale; I walk blind anyway.

lines.zh: 这片废土我不挑，随便走
lines.en: I don't mind this waste, I walk anywhere.
My tail flicks and sweeps up ash.

lines.zh: 站着，让周围的空气变沉
lines.en: I stand, and the air around me grows heavy.
The soil beneath me starts turning grey.
I don't chew grass, I only grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 骨头戳出皮，我也不在意
lines.en: Bone pokes through my hide and I don't care.
Within four blocks, no one moves fast.
Heat rises off my back.

lines.zh: 一动不动的牛最没意思
lines.en: A motionless cow is a dull thing.
I'm listening for whose breath falters first.
My neck stiffens when my head hangs too long.

lines.zh: 这片地已经死透了，正合适
lines.en: This land is already dead, which suits it.
You're close enough now.
You dare look at me like this?

lines.zh: 我身上在冒灰，闻到了吗
lines.en: Ash drifts off me; do you smell it?
A living thing, it's been a while.
Don't look at the wounds on my back.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，腿就沉一分
lines.en: One step closer and your legs will feel heavy.
I know the look of the living.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有黑，只有白
lines.en: My eyes have no black, only white.
You're gauging the distance, and so am I.

lines.zh: 牛不叫了，只剩粗重的气
lines.en: The cow no longer lowes, only breathes heavy.
Bone and flesh ache together.
That tore a slab of hide off.
Ash shakes loose from my back
No use, the wither stays in me.
You're hitting dead meat.
Blood squeezes out of the split.
My hide splits; I don't cry out
The pain pulls a low from me.
The bone under my hide shows through.
A few more and I still won't fall.
Grass? I've long forgotten its taste.
Living wheat won't feed me.
You hold up hay, and I don't move.

lines.zh: 凋零的东西才对我胃口
lines.en: Withering things are what suit my appetite.

lines.zh: 草味飘过来，只让我更渴
lines.en: The smell of grass only makes me thirstier.
Put the grass down and back up.

lines.zh: 这片地里长的东西，我都不吃
lines.en: I eat nothing that grows in this land.
If you have rotten flesh, toss it over.
What feeds me should be dead first.
I sniff it and take half a step away.
Bump me and you'll start slowing.
Don't press against my hide.
These bones hit hard.
I back off, and the stench is on you.
Stay out of four blocks.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩过你的脚面，抱歉不了
lines.en: My hoof crossed your foot; I can't be sorry.
Ash fell all over you.
One bump and your face changes.
Two cows won't fit here.
Move, I don't want to stop.
The byre is gone, and so are my kind.
In this body, who is left for me?

lines.zh: 夜里牧场有另一声低鸣
lines.en: Somewhere in the pasture another low answer comes.
Two shadows lean at the fence.

lines.zh: 我们不产小牛，只把病传下去
lines.en: We make no calves, we only pass the rot along.
Wither spreads between us too.

lines.zh: 它也在冒灰，闻着像同类
lines.en: It gives off ash too, smells like my own.

lines.zh: 棚子塌了，我们没地方去
lines.en: The shed fell in and we have nowhere to go.
No one will milk us again.
We scatter before dawn.

lines.zh: 地上的肉，我一个都不放过
lines.en: I let no meat on the ground pass.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿沾了我的味，你还要吗
lines.en: That thing has my stench on it, still want it?
I dip my head and bite it, but my teeth fail.
What I can't chew, I stomp into the soil.

lines.zh: 掉的东西归我，活物归你
lines.en: Dropped things are mine, living things are yours.
I carry a bone in my teeth.
This won't even fill a tooth.
My hoof nudges it and it rolls aside.
I won't pick it up; it rots on its own.

lines.zh: 地上的东西都是死的，正合适
lines.en: Everything on the ground is dead, which fits.
The smell of life, from over there.
I lift my head.
The grass around here is too clean.
Something's moving, and it isn't wind.
Within four blocks, it can't run.
I turn toward it, slowly.
I paw the ground, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 这个人的腿，会先沉下来
lines.en: This one's legs will grow heavy first.
This is close enough; no need to run.
I lower my head, horns forward.
That one, reeking of iron and sweat.
The wind pushes it toward me.
It hasn't noticed I'm looking.
I hold still and wait for it to come.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我给你留个印子
lines.en: A little closer and I'll leave my mark.

lines.zh: 它慢了半拍，我的灰起了作用
lines.en: It's half a beat slower; my ash is working.
I don't chase, I wait.
It goes left, so I block from the right.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩地，一下重过一下
lines.en: My hoof strikes the ground, heavier each time.
Raise your shield to my horn, the horn keeps coming.
Blood rolls under my hide, hot enough to charge.
It backed off, but not far enough.
I can smell it starting to panic.
I low once, and the air gets heavier.
It tries to circle, and I see it.
Last three steps, I stop counting.
My shadow reaches your feet first.
Don't turn around; if you do, I charge.
My horns hit and it topples back.

lines.zh: 这一顶带着凋零，伤口不会好
lines.en: This gore carries wither; the wound won't close.
My hooves come down and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 撞完就往后退，惯性别浪费
lines.en: I hit and back off; don't waste momentum.

lines.zh: 它的腿开始沉，正合我意
lines.en: Its legs start to drag, just as I wanted.
My bony shoulder hits the chest.
I gore the knee and make him kneel.

lines.zh: 一记横扫的角，划开衣服
lines.en: A sweeping horn tears the cloth.
Ash clouds him and he can't breathe.
The rest of the pain will come slowly.
It's retreating, so I add one more gore.

lines.zh: 角卡住了，我甩头拔出来
lines.en: My horn sticks, and I shake it free.
This one will take a long time to heal.
As it falls, I'm smelling the blood.

lines.zh: 下界的岩缝里，我站起来了
lines.en: I rise out of a crack in the netherrack.

lines.zh: 火里出来一头烧不透的牛
lines.en: Out of the fire comes a cow that won't burn.
I open my eyes and see ash.

lines.zh: 蹄子第一次踏在这块废土
lines.en: My hooves touch this waste for the first time.
The bones knit themselves together.
Something living has wandered into this land.

lines.zh: 空气中多了一股凋零味
lines.en: The air gains a smell of wither.
Half the hide hangs off, and it will do.

lines.zh: 我低鸣一声，四周都静了
lines.en: I low once and everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 从岩壁后面走出来，慢得吓人
lines.en: I come round the rock wall, dreadfully slow.

lines.zh: 这片地太干净，得弄脏些
lines.en: This place is too clean; I'll dirty it.

lines.zh: 头顶的红光照在骨头上
lines.en: The red light above falls on my bones.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，只是烤干了皮
lines.en: Fire does nothing but dry my hide.
I fell, and a bone slipped out of place.
Water washes the ash off me.
The blast numbs half of me.
An arrow sinks in and the meat doesn't bleed.

lines.zh: 法术在我身上找不到活的地方
lines.en: The spell finds nothing living to take hold of.

lines.zh: 饿不饿都一样，身体在烂
lines.en: Hunger doesn't matter; the body rots anyway.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，骨头亮了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my bones flash white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，我照样浮着坠落
lines.en: In the void there's no air, yet I fall all the same.
